messages:
mara: Heads-up — competitor (EdgeAI) just announced 'multi-tier routing' publicly. Got a few customer asks this morning. Need a quick convo on scope: parity vs double-down on our cost-aware routing differentiator.

devon: Saw the release. Their thing is basically an automated tier fallthrough by region + price. We have smart routing but not the same UX. Quick question: is parity just API surface or infra changes?

sam: Sales here — 3 customer calls today asking if we can match EdgeAI's 'auto-fallback across tiers'. They said they'd consider switching if we don't have an answer by EOW. Not yet urgent but definitely momentum.

anya: CS echoes — pilot customer raised it as a blocker for a rollout next month. Quote: "we need automatic failover to cheaper regions during spikes." They want predictable latency SLAs.

nate: Research note — we already have a prototype for cost-aware fallback in the runtime (internal branch: feature/cost-fallback). It handles weighted routing + KV cache sync, but no public API or console controls.

devon: Rough effort guess: 2-week spike (1 eng + 0.5 infra + 0.5 runtime) to prove feasibility for Hosted. Full product rollout (API + Console + docs + tests) ~ 4-6 sprints. Private/Dedicated adds integration work.

mara: Two high-level options: A) Ship parity (match API/UX) for Hosted quickly to avoid churn. B) Invest in our differentiated 'cost-aware routing' with better observability and rollout controls — longer runway but stronger positioning. Need decision on scope for next sprint.

jenna: Important: if we pick A (parity) we should scope it Hosted-only for MVP. Dedicated/Private can be scheduled Q3, to avoid blocking enterprise contracts. Also need launch criteria: API, console toggle, doc + 5 customer tests.

sam: +1 to Hosted-only parity MVP. Give sales something to point at while we iterate on the unique feature.

anya: Agreed Hosted-only for parity, but include telemetry hooks so we can compare usage vs our cost-aware approach later. Customers will expect metrics.

nate: Implementation note / sketch:
```
routing:
  policy: [latency, cost, tier]
  fallback_order: [same-region, cheaper-region, cached-variant]
  max_extra_latency_ms: 50
```
We can reuse KV-sync code from the prototype.

devon: If we scope parity to Hosted-only, ETA for a canary in prod ~3 sprints: 2 sprints dev + 1 sprint for hardening and docs. Spike will confirm the 3-sprint estimate.

mara: Decision call: run 1-week spike this sprint to validate infra cost and cache correctness; aim to ship Hosted parity MVP in 3 sprints if spike is green. Dedicated/Private deferred. Owner: devon + nate. Deliverables for spike: infra BOM, KV-consistency test, API draft, perf target (p95 delta < 30ms).

sam: Noted — I'll flag to top accounts that we have a roadmap commitment and can offer a private pilot after spike.

anya: I'll prep the customer test plan and sample prompts.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: spike-branch -> staging at 2023-05-10T09:30:00Z (dry run). :rocket:

mara: Thanks all — will summarize in the roadmap doc and update stakeholders. If anyone has blockers speak up here.
